retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: the earthquake of 28 February 1969, epicentre in the Atlantic south-west of Cape St Vincent, felt across Portugal, southern Spain and northern Morocco, the largest to strike the country since 1755; thirteen people died. Note that the leads disagree about its size, English Wikipedia giving magnitude 7.8 and Portuguese 8. A disaster with no consequence the atlas holds.

title: 1969 Portugal earthquake
